title: characterization-inputs/1
description: The authored inputs of one segment's characterization: data/characterization/inputs/<segment name>.yaml (docs/briefs/ariadne/upper-arm-characterization-brief.md, T5; CONVENTIONS sections 2 and 8). Only values that live in decision prose and in no address. Each entry is {value, unit, source}, the source one or more decision clauses. A change to a decision record that moves a value a characterization inputs file carries edits that file in the same commit.

side.description: The right side only; the left is its mirror (CONVENTIONS section 3, CAD frame).

shell.description: The shell thickness inside the skin that bounds the available volume (adr-0007 D4).

anchor_bars.description: The error bar of each joint node the segment's frames use, by node name (elbow, wrist, shoulder). A bar a record states is a number; one no record states is the string `unstated` (adr-0045 D6(b)), never 0.

rom.description: Range-of-motion inputs that no address holds. The anatomical range is read from the snapshot and is not here.

mechanism_ends.description: Ends of the mechanism's travel stated only in a decision, by direction (flexion, extension). An end the snapshot holds is read from it and is not here.

loaded_arc.description: The arc over which payload loads are claimed. Null with source_needed while its bounds are unsourced (adr-0008 D2).

payloads.description: Payloads by name (design, nominal), each in kg, with `at` saying where it is applied.

swing_rows.description: Inertial rows by id (S1, S2, S3; adr-0008 D3), each an amplitude, a duration and a payload.

bsip_spread.description: The spread every self-weight term carries (adr-0008 D2).

fall_contact_points.description: Per fall case id, where on the segment chain the case's force is applied and its rating, when a decision gives them (adr-0008 D5, D6(f)).

fall_flags.description: The flag of each (case, this segment) pair (adr-0045 D5(e)), by case id. Every case that reaches the segment through fall_cases or fall_contacts needs one.

value.description: The number as the clause states it; a label (structural, wrist); or null with source_needed.

unit.description: The value's unit (mm, deg, kg, s, kN, %); null for a label.

at.description: Where a quantity applies (a payload's point, a contact's point).

direction.description: The direction a bar or a rating is stated in (anteroposterior, axial compression).

source_needed.description: The clause marks the value [source needed]; value is then null.
